purpose: Six evidence gates for an urban AI asset to be accepted, repaired, retested, and released or correctly refused.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored operating contract only. It defines role types, records, pause conditions, and evidence needed for later professional work. It does not name real institutions, certify products, authorize treatment, approve construction, or claim field performance.

gates.decision_question_zh: 设备、故障与请求是否属于本次受理范围？
gates.decision_question_en: Are the asset, fault, and requested service within the declared intake scope?
gates.independent_review_role_type: none at intake; escalate safety cases
gates.pause_trigger: Any immediate danger or loss of an equivalent non-digital service route.
gates.resume_evidence: Hazard isolation and a restored staffed or equivalent public-service route.

gates.decision_question_zh: 谁有权送修、拆检、读取或擦除数据，谁继续承担保修责任？
gates.decision_question_en: Who may submit, inspect, access, or erase the asset, and who retains warranty responsibility?
gates.independent_review_role_type: data-governance or warranty reviewer when required
gates.pause_trigger: Any conflict in ownership, warranty, data access, erasure, or software licence.
gates.resume_evidence: Resolved authority record and an updated limited work scope.

gates.decision_question_zh: 设备能否在场内安全诊断，还是必须隔离并转交资格范围匹配设施？
gates.decision_question_en: Can the asset be diagnosed safely on site, or must it be isolated and handed to a scope-matched facility?
hard_blockers: suspected hazardous condition without controlled route
formal treatment activity outside operator scope
gates.independent_review_role_type: environmental or safety professional when classification is uncertain
gates.pause_trigger: Suspected hazardous material, damaged energy storage, uncontrolled movement, or unsafe energisation.
gates.resume_evidence: Professional classification and either a safe diagnostic method or a qualified handover receipt.

gates.decision_question_zh: 拟维修、换件或翻新动作是否获授权，候选部件是否有足够适配证据？
gates.decision_question_en: Is the proposed repair authorized, and is the candidate part supported by sufficient compatibility evidence?
gates.pause_trigger: Any failed or missing compatibility dimension, recall, or undocumented configuration change.
gates.resume_evidence: Correct part evidence, revised work scope, and professional acceptance of the test plan.

gates.decision_question_zh: 设备在声明版本、工况和安全边界内是否恢复可重复表现？
gates.decision_question_en: Has repeatable performance been restored within the declared version, operating condition, and safety envelope?
gates.independent_review_role_type: independent reviewer appropriate to the equipment family
gates.pause_trigger: Any failure against the declared baseline, safety function, or public accessibility contract.
gates.resume_evidence: Corrective work plus a complete new retest; previous failed evidence remains retained.

gates.decision_question_zh: 证据是否足以由责任角色签发限定范围的复役回执，或应继续暂停/退回/合规转交？
gates.decision_question_en: Is the evidence sufficient for accountable human release within a limited scope, or must the asset remain held, be returned, or be handed over?
gates.independent_review_role_type: test/calibration/safety reviewer appropriate to the release scope
gates.pause_trigger: Any missing sign-off, erasure evidence, unresolved critical risk, or mismatch between receipt and test scope.
gates.resume_evidence: Closed evidence gap and joint accountable plus independent sign-off.
